novidades: Novo: o celular vira a webcam do PC. No celular, abra Modos > Webcam do PC; no PC, escolha "Reflex Câmera" no Zoom, Teams, Meet ou OBS. E agora o Reflex mostra as novidades de cada versão.
novidades_en: New: your phone becomes the PC webcam. On the phone, open Modes > PC webcam; on the PC, pick "Reflex Câmera" in Zoom, Teams, Meet or OBS. Reflex now also shows what's new in each version.
